parsed.why: Top-tier protections operating: court forced hospital to resume care (2026), all-gender facility access law, 2025 name/pronoun act, GI hate-crime since 2001. Capped by national border/document regime; youth-coverage suspension and pending ballot measures.

Worst legal-risk tier; gender identity stripped from civil-rights law leaving no service-refusal remedy, and the school restroom rule binds visitors by birth certificate. National border and custody exposure still applies on top.

Worst-laws category: birth-sex school facility rule, 2017 religious-refusal statute enabling service denial, no GI hate-crime protection, hostile 2025 name-change ruling. Only dated 2017 federal murder prosecution as recourse.

Most Protective tier: constitutional GI amendment, GENDA, mandated gender-neutral bathrooms, repeal of the police loitering law used against trans people, shield law, 82% support, no documented trans violence. National border regime caps.

Mixed: GI anti-discrimination enforced in 2026 civil-rights ruling, hate-crime coverage, panic defence abolished, 88% support; but recent youth-care bans, sports ban, surgery-only birth-certificate rule, high raw incident count.
